title: AutoGoal permanently cancels a successor with no log when source data is incomplete
current: If the source goal's data lacks goal or completedTime, the scheduled successor is cancelled and nothing is logged.
evidence: loadCompletedSourceGoal calls cancelAutoCreateNextGoal and returns without logDiagnostic. A read glitch or partial write ends AutoGoal for that community (characteristic E).
investigate: When can getSubGoalData return no completedTime for a scheduled source?
This should log at warn and defer or re-check rather than cancel.

criticality.why: It silently and permanently stops the next goal from ever being created.
